title: Point the contributor guide at the bounded pickup
lead: AGENTS.md is what an agent reads before the published skill, and it still fetches the whole slice.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** changing `slicer next` or the skill text.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `AGENTS.md` tells a contributor to run `slicer next` and then `slicer show`, and to `start` and `done` with `--render` and no `--strict`. That guide is loaded as a project rule, so it undoes the bounded pickup in the skill. An agent following it reads every section and can leave a saved change behind when rendering fails.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `AGENTS.md` (the "Working on the roadmap" commands)
- `tests/test_ai.py` or a small test that reads `AGENTS.md`

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. The pickup commands in `AGENTS.md` name `slicer next --ready` with repeatable `--section`, `--json`, and `--lean`.
2. `start` and slice edits there use `--render --strict`. `done` stays `--render`.
3. A test reads those sentences from `AGENTS.md`, so a later edit cannot put `slicer next` plus `slicer show` back as the pickup.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Update the roadmap commands in `AGENTS.md` to the same pickup, start, and edit lines the skill uses. Keep the install, invariants, and house-style sections. Do not paste the skill or `docs/agents.md` into the file.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: The three cases above pass. `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests` and `slicer check` pass.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit. Do not tag or push.
